text: QCon San Francisco 2026 Venue: Hyatt Regency Embarcadero Conference: Nov 16-18, 2026 Training: Nov 19-20, 2026 Hyatt Regency, SF 2026 Schedule Tracks Speakers Training Teams Certification We Care Venue & Hotel FAQ Log in Register 2026 Schedule Tracks Speakers Training Teams Certification We Care Venue & Hotel FAQ Log in Register 2026 Schedule Tracks Speakers Training Teams Certification We Care Venue & Hotel FAQ Venue & Hotel QCon SF 2026 Venue: Hyatt Regency Embarcadero 5 Embarcadero Center, San Francisco, CA 94111, USA ( View on map ) Limited availability: Rooms in our official conference block are selling our fast and certain nights are already sold out. Check availability for remaining negotiated conference rates here . Nearby Hotels for QCon Attendees To ensure you secure the best accommodations within your budget, we recommend booking as early as possible. We have partnered with BCD M&E to provide discounted rates and a wider selection of nearby hotel options. Exclusive Rates: Access a variety of nearby hotels at the lowest available rates, with zero administration or handling fees. Group Bookings: Special group discounts are available if you are booking 9 or more rooms. Browse and Book Nearby Hotel Rooms for QCon SF 2026 . Need assistance with your booking? Contact the accommodation support team directly at [contact redacted] . ⚠️ Official Venue and Hotel Information Only the venue and hotel information listed on this official page has been approved by QCon. QCon will never email you directly about hotel bookings or expiring room rates. If you receive an email of this nature or suspect any other phishing attempt using the QCon brand, please forward it immediately to [contact redacted] ( [contact redacted] ) . 🏨Hotel Details & Amenities ⏱️ Check-in: 4:00 PM | Check-out: 12:00 PM 📶 Connectivity: Free Wi-Fi in the lobby 🚭 Atmosphere: 100% Non-smoking hotel Booking hotel accommodations is up to the attendee; QCon does not arrange reservations. 🚗Parking Information 🅿️ Covered Self-Parking: from $45/overnight. Located at 3 Embarcadero Center. No in-and-out privileges. Please take all personal items with you. EV charging stations are available. (Note: This public garage is not affiliated with the hotel). 🛎️ Valet Parking: from $99/overnight. Includes in-and-out privileges. Getting Here ✈️ From SFO (14 miles) 🚆 BART (Train): $11.15 (approx. 34 mins). Take any Northbound (San Francisco-bound) train directly to Embarcadero Station. The hotel is located right outside the station! Trains run every 15-20 minutes. 🚕 Ride-share / Taxi: Estimated $28 - $50 (25-40 mins) ✈️ From OAK (20 miles) 🚆 BART (Train): ~$12.65 (approx. 40 mins). Take the Oakland Airport connector train and make 1 transfer at Coliseum Station to a San Francisco-bound train. Exit at Embarcadero Station.
